If you're building an iOS app with a widget, a Watch companion (that's the watchOS app paired with your main iPhone app), or a Share Extension, you'll eventually need to pass data between processes. App Groups are the standard mechanism for this, and on the surface it looks simple: add the capability, write UserDefaults(suiteName:), and off you go. But that apparent simplicity is exactly what causes problems. Data sits in an unencrypted container, any app from your team can read it, and incoming data validation is almost never done. articles.author: Tresor
articles.description:
Laravel has Stringable for strings, but numeric logic in apps often still looks messy.
I just released laravel-numberable v1.0.0: a small package for fluent numeric operations and formatting in Laravel.
Numbers in apps usually need more than + and -:
parsing user input
currency / percentage formatting
rounding
comparisons
business rule helpers
I wanted something chainable and expressive.
composer require tresor-kasenda/laravel-numberable

$price = number(1999.99)
    ->withLocale('en_US')
    ->withCurrency('USD');

$price->asCurrency();

$total = number(120)
    ->add(30)
    ->multiply(1.2)
    ->round(2);

number(15)->clamp(0, 10);   // 10
number(10.0)->trim();       // 10
number(17)->isPrime();      // true
number(12)->isEven();       // true
number(10)->between(5, 15); // true

number(0.157)->asPercentage();
number(1532000)->asAbbreviated();
number(1048576)->asFileSize();
number(21)->asOrdinal();

localized parsing (from('1 234,50', 'fr_FR'))
when() / unless() pipelines
macros and custom formats
Laravel 10 / 11 / 12
PHP 8.3 / 8.4
Release: v1.0.0

Repo: github.com/Tresor-Kasenda/laravel-numberable



Feedback is welcome, especially around API naming and missing numeric helpers.
Tags: laravel php opensource webdev
articles.title: I built a fluent Numberable API for Laravel (v1.0.0)

The developer visits a malicious website in their browser
